indicator_definition: Number of intentional homicides per 100,000 inhabitants. Defined as unlawful death inflicted with intent to cause death or serious injury. Data compiled by Eurostat from national criminal justice statistics.
rationale: The homicide rate is one of the most reliable measures of violent crime and public safety. Progress means a sustained reduction in intentional homicide rates.
methodology_characteristics: Data compiled by Eurostat from national police and criminal justice statistics following UNODC definitions. Published annually.
